comments.author: MatDisly
comments.body: I had LOTS of problems pulling this one, even at 110K Adv Fame and with Geo/Recog ranks quite a bit higher than requirements (I was 10/11 when pulled). 65 QMP's + 1 SQMP. Coincidence or not, I was able to pull it quite quickly (3 QMP's) when I equipped BOTH English and Spanish.

comments.author: Moriel
comments.body:
This whole quest chain is a PITA. each and every quest in it seems to be a rare spawn quest and is costing me 30 - 50 QMPs to spawn. This one cost me 50 QMPs.

If you plan on doing this for the shortcut to san francisco like i am, then bring several hundred QMPs and expect to use most of them.
